description: I am ApexSolo. An individual developer who creates interactive  web experiences and games for NASA Space Apps Challenge. I am representing Sunwal and trying to be in the top!
summary:
RES-1 is a 3D game that works in any web browser. It works on computers and phones. The player is the crew member of a Mars habitat. The player has 20 sols to survive. The player manages oxygen, energy, supplies and hull integrity. The player sends a rover to mine water ice. The player sends a scout robot to six science sites. Each science site is based on a NASA discovery. The player builds a research journal, about Mars’ past.

Dust storms, flares, meteor strikes, cold snaps and equipment failures test the players planning. Each hazard comes with a NASA fact card. The game uses data. The real data includes the Mars fact sheet. The real data includes Curiosity’s radiation measurements. The real data includes the 2018 dust storm. The 2018 dust storm silenced the Opportunity rover. The game says clearly which numbers are scaled or invented for gameplay.

The game has three difficulty levels. The game works with a keyboard. The game works with touch. The game works with screen readers.
details: ARES-1 is an interactive, browser-based 3D survival simulation built with Three.js that challenges players to manage a Martian outpost for 20 sols. Grounded in real NASA planetary, radiation, and atmospheric telemetry, players must balance oxygen, power, radiation shielding, and structural integrity while deploying an exploration rover across a realistic Martian terrain.
